records.name: Wu Xing Quan
records.styleText: You are a master of the 5 animals style and can imitate their movements.

records.name: Long weapons
records.styleText: You are a master in using the spear, trident, and halberd, distance keeping weapons.

records.name: Blunt weapons
records.styleText: You are a master in using hammer, tonfa, and nunchaku, weapons that favor power over elegance.

records.name: Edged weapons
records.styleText: You are a master in Jian and Dao weapons, swords and sabers, symbols of martial virtue.

records.name: Improvised weapons
records.styleText: You are a master in the use of fans, stools, umbrellas, throwing tiles, etc. You can always find a weapon.
records.power: You can always find a weapon

records.name: Drunken style
records.styleText: As long as you have alcohol, you can surprise your enemy and ignore damage from the first hit. You are unpredictable.
records.power: As long as you have alcohol, you can surprise your enemy and ignore damage from the first hit
records.powerClass: needs an alcohol item and a per-fight "first hit" flag

records.name: Iron fist style
records.styleText: You have trained with metal rings, greatly increasing your arms' strength.

records.name: Shaolin Quan
records.styleText: You are a trained warrior in both armed and hand to hand combat but you cannot kill. Regarded as a religious person you can beg for food or lodging.
records.power: you cannot kill. Regarded as a religious person you can beg for food or lodging
records.powerClass: an opponent at ENDURANCE 0 cannot die

records.name: Cult of the Great Immortals
records.styleText: Tricks or magic, people see you as a superior being. You can turn iron into gold, read minds, walk on fire, etc.
records.power: You can turn iron into gold, read minds, walk on fire, etc.

records.name: Qin Na
records.styleText: You know the Xue Wei, pressure points that control the flow of Qi, and you can activate them with your fingers.

records.name: Shuai Jiao
records.styleText: A style practiced by the northern nomads. A grappling art with throws, takedowns and sweeps

records.name: Red Boat Wing Chun
records.styleText: A close-quarters system practiced within a shadow organization operating across territories.

records.name: Praying Mantis Style
records.styleText: Your finishing blow is always lethal, and you can hit small targets with finger strikes.
records.power: Your finishing blow is always lethal, and you can hit small targets with finger strikes

records.name: Tiger Hooks
records.styleText: You are a master of hooked swords, effective at all ranges for cutting, piercing, tearing, hooking.

records.name: Double Knives
records.styleText: You are a master of Lu Jiao Dao and Hudie Shuang Dao, effective against long weapons and at close range.

records.name: 9-Section chain whip
records.styleText: You are a master in Jiu Jie Bian, a concealable weapon capable of entangling your opponents.
records.power: a concealable weapon capable of entangling

records.name: Wudang Quan
records.styleText: An ancient style linked to ancestral rites. You can use Rituals in combat.
records.power: You can use Rituals in combat
records.powerClass: Rituals allowed in combat, the one exception to R14

records.name: TaiJi Quan
records.styleText: A style with fluid, circular movements, favoring the use of inner strength.
